title: The Bowl of Strawberries
youtube_title: The Bowl of Strawberries | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Ines sees that a bowl of strawberries still cool from the rinse will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Ines makes a smaller, even share so Nia is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
